idea-plugin.name: Syok Code
idea-plugin.description:
Syok Code in your JetBrains editor. Opens the editor's own terminal and starts the syok program there: open a chat, give it a task, or select some code and ask about it. Your own provider keys, switched automatically by Syok.

Needs the Syok Code command-line program (one line to install; the add-on shows it when the program is missing). Find the commands under Tools | Syok Code and in the editor's right-click menu.

action.description: Open a Syok Code chat in the terminal
Type a task for Syok Code and start it in the terminal
